snippet.title: Disbond - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A PvP multiplayer zombie shooter. 2 game modes. 8 classes. One of you is already infected. You just don't know which one yet. Barricade, escape, retaliate.. Do what you must to survive and lead the scoreboard, but who can you truly trust? Because one bite turns you and the wrong turn bites you. 

👉 Wishlist Disbond on Steam
🎮 Free demo during Steam Next Fest, Oct 19 to 26
